blocks.text: Pages are those the project's own search returns for "Uganda", so some only mention it. Views are from July 2015; sizes are the current size of each page.

items.b: 1,360 pages on Wiktionary (English) mention Uganda, written from 2002 onward and read 17,764,369 times since July 2015. The median page has been read 572 times.
“English” alone holds 7.6% of all views, and the ten most read pages hold 26%. Readership is spread across many pages rather than a few.
Views peaked in 2019 at 2,002,036. The last full year, 2025, drew 1,791,826, close to the peak. So far in 2026: 1,226,432 views.
Most pages were written in 2025 (126). In the last five calendar years (2022–2026, the last one part-way) 407 pages were written, against 147 in the five years before that — the pace is picking up.
4,132 registered accounts have edited these pages in all. Editors peaked in 2026 (706); in 2025 there were 548.
66% of pages are stubs (under 1,000 bytes) and 4% are long (20,000 bytes and over).
“No Wikidata item” affects 1,360 pages (100%). Suggested action: Connect to Wikidata.
0% of pages are linked to a Wikidata item, and 0% have no Luganda article for the subject — 0 candidates for translation.
80% of pages were edited in the last year; 18 (1%) have not been touched for five years or more.

blocks.text: Pages written, edits and editors come from each page's own edit history, so they reach back to the first page. Views are recorded only from July 2015. Editors are registered accounts, counted once a year.
